scope: Test the strongest remaining external-evidence hypothesis: whether the documented SA agreement depends on historical OpenFOAM Foundation v4 solver/model behavior rather than current OpenCFD v2512 behavior.

evidence_basis.reported_observation: One independent user reported NASA-like SA lift with OpenFOAM Foundation v4 and about a 10 percent shift with OpenCFD v2006 using the same case files.
evidence_basis.caveat: The report does not prove that the official openfoam.com plot was generated with Foundation v4; this is a lineage screen, not an attribution claim.

single_change.name: OpenFOAM_solver_and_SA_lineage
single_change.initialization: Copy the settled v2512 ratio-4/no-ft2 fields to time zero, then execute with Foundation v4.
single_change.compatibility_adapters: Allow only dictionary-key/library-name changes required for v4 to parse and report the same mathematical case; record every adapter and hash. No physical or numerical setting may change silently.

fixed.grid: official NASA 897x257 C-grid with verified direct PLOT3D topology parity
fixed.schemes_relaxation_and_force_normalizati: mathematically unchanged after explicit compatibility translation

screen_decision.material_toward_official_plot: last-100 mean Cd decreases by at least 0.00005 relative to the v2512 source
screen_decision.null_effect: absolute last-100 mean Cd change is at most 0.00002
screen_decision.ambiguous_effect: absolute change is between 0.00002 and 0.00005 or moves away; retain and diagnose without tuning

terminal_rule: Run a parse/mesh smoke check first. If compatibility requires a physics or discretization change, stop and revise the plan. Otherwise stop after 1000 solver iterations; extend only under a separately declared plan if the result moves materially toward the official plot.
